caseName: Wisconsin Department of Corrections v. Schacht
caseNameFull: Wisconsin Department of Corrections v. Schacht

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioners is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, February 27, 1998. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, March 27, 1998. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, April 13,1998. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
